svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The universal state machine behind LunexObject.state (Sub-model 1) — shared by every class
the full machine above is the maximum — an object only uses the states its class needs
example: a simple Sensor (no lock, no inhibit function)
Locked/Inhibited branches exist in the model but are never reached —
this class simply has no transitions into them
Out of scope here: collective status across the hierarchy.
A child can carry more than one condition at once (e.g. Inhibited and Emergency Stopping
together) — that is not a simple worst-case reduction and is described in Sub-model 9 (Collective Status / Rollup).
LunexObject.state (Sub-model 1) is one instance of this machine.
LunexObject.health stays independent — diagnostics, not operating mode.
state not used by this object class
